assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW original compact spot illustration for a Korean engineering textbook chapter on sending a web security test request. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: 1990s PC-98 adventure-game pixel art, crisp visible pixel clusters, limited indigo/cyan/pink colors, flat color areas and checkerboard dithering. Scene: a shaded university courtyard with a low concrete bench, tiled paving, brick facade and a small leafy tree at twilight. One adult authorized security tester in a dark hooded jacket sits on the bench, seen naturally from behind at a rear three-quarter angle, typing a single test request on an open laptop resting on their knees. Laptop screen faces the person, only plausible edge glimpse or backside from this viewpoint; no readable interface. A small notebook and closed tool pouch on the bench relate to recording the test. No headset, no office desk, no weapons, no floating symbols, no readable words or numbers, no logo, no watermarks. Localized landscape vignette with genuinely transparent outer margins, clear silhouette readable when printed 55mm wide, whole bench/person contained with generous margins, consistent perspective, no soft painting or gradients. Maintain the reference's retro pixel technique but use a new character, new pose and new courtyard setting.

The terminal screen faces her and its opaque back faces the viewer. She is checking the response and log from a web test. New person, location, pose and props distinct from the reference. No desk, office chair, headset, readable text, numbers, floating interface, logos, watermark, or impossible transparent device. Localized compact scene with truly transparent outer margins, whole character contained, readable at 55mm print width, crisp flat pixel colors, consistent perspective, not photorealistic or soft painted.
